# Anti-Defensive Anything

[中文](README.md) · English

**Make AI stop writing "just to avoid being wrong": a lightweight, zero-dependency set of Agent Skills.**

> Output exists to achieve the goal, not to avoid blame.

Admitting fault up front in papers, defensive fallbacks and swallowed exceptions all over the code, only daring incremental ideas when brainstorming, "it depends" as advice, asking permission for every step of a task: once installed, the AI gives conclusions, makes trade-offs, and finishes the job in these scenarios. Risks that actually affect your decisions still get stated clearly.

## Installation

**Claude Code (recommended)**: run in Claude Code

```
/plugin install anti-defensive-anything --marketplace lyyi599/anti-defensive-anything
```

<details>
<summary>Older Claude Code (before 2.1.275)</summary>

```
/plugin marketplace add lyyi599/anti-defensive-anything
/plugin install anti-defensive-anything@lyyi599-anti-defensive
```
</details>

**Codex / other Agent tools**:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lyyi599/anti-defensive-anything.git
cd anti-defensive-anything
scripts/install.sh --target ~/.codex/skills   # without --target, installs to ~/.claude/skills
```

**Web chat / tools that don't support skills**: paste [`prompts/quick-prompt-en.md`](prompts/quick-prompt-en.md) at the start of the conversation.

> The skill body is written in Chinese and works equally well for English requests (compared against a fully translated English skill in our evaluation, the English version showed no advantage). Replies follow the language you ask in.

## Usage

Once installed, just make your requests as usual. The skill kicks in automatically by scenario:

| Scenario | Example prompts |
|---|---|
| Writing | "Polish this abstract", "Write a rebuttal", "Revise my résumé" |
| Coding | "Refactor this module", "Review this code", "Clean up the over-defensive code" |
| Ideas | "Brainstorm some research ideas around X" |
| Advice | "PostgreSQL or MongoDB?", "Be direct: is this plan viable?" |
| Execution | "Just finish it, stop asking me" |

In any scenario, if the AI starts hedging again, say "don't be so defensive."
